profiles.name: Blazing Weapons
chars: Cypher can use his pistols in your Shooting phase even if he has Advanced or Fallen Back in the same turn.

profiles.name: Mysterious Protection
chars: Cypher has a 4+ invulnerable save. In addition, roll a D6 if Cypher is slain. On a roll of 2+, Cypher's model is still removed from play, but he is not considered to have been slain for the purposes of any mission victory conditions.

profiles.name: Lord Cypher
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 made for friendly FALLEN units within 6" of Cypher

profiles.name: No-one's Puppet
chars: Cypher cannot use the Daemonic Ritual ability, even though he has the CHAOS and CHARACTER keywords.

profiles.name: Agent of Discord
chars: Enemy units within 12" of CYPHER cannot use any abilities, Warlord Traits or Relics that allow them to gain, return or refund Command Points. The range of this ability is increased to 18" while there are 10 or more other friendly FALLEN ANGELS models within 12" of CYPHER. The range of this ability is instead increased to 24" while there are 20 or more other friendly FALLEN ANGELS models within 12" of CYPHER.

profiles.name: Sorcerer
chars: Smite and 2 powers from the Dark Hereticus discipline

profiles.name: Fallen Angels
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for any Fallen unit when shooting (including when firing Overwatch) as long as the unit did not move in its last Movement phase. In addition, Fallen units can never lose more than 1 model as the result of any single failed Morale test; any additional casualties beyond the first are ignored.

profiles.name: Jump Pack Assault
chars: During deployment, if this model has a jump pack, you can set it up high in the skies instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases this model can assault from above – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from any enemy models.

profiles.name: Flamer
chars: This weapon automatically hits its target.

profiles.name: Meltagun
chars: When resolving an attack with this weapon against a target that is within half range, roll two D6 when inflicting damage with it and discard one of the results.

profiles.name: Thunder hammer
chars: When attacking with this weapon, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Smite
chars: If manifested, the closest visible enemy unit within 18" of the psyker suffers 1 mortal wound. If the result of the Psychic test was more than 10 the target suffers D3 mortal wounds instead.

profiles.name: Infernal Gaze
chars: If manifested, select a visible enemy unit within 18" of the psyker and roll 3 dice. The target suffers one mortal wound for each roll of 4+.

profiles.name: Diabolic Strength
chars: If manifested, select a HERETIC ASTARTES model within 12" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, add 2 to the model's Strength characteristic and 1 to its Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: Warptime
chars: If manifested, pick a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 3" of the psyker. That unit can immediately move as if it were its Movement phase. You cannot use Warptime on a unit more than once in each Psychic phase.

profiles.name: Gift of Chaos
chars: If manifested, select an enemy unit that is within 6" of the psyker and visible to him and roll a D6. If the result is greater than the enemy's Toughness, it suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. If a CHARACTER is slain by this power, you can add a Chaos Spawn to your army and set it up within 1" of the character before it is removed.

profiles.name: Prescience
chars: If manifested, select a HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 18" of the psyker. You can add 1 to all hit rolls made for that unit until the start of your next Psychic phase.

profiles.name: Death Hex
chars: If manifested, select a visible enemy unit within 12" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, that unit cannot take invulnerable saves.

rules.name: Daemon Weapon
rules.text: In the Fight phase, when this model is chosen to fight with for the first time that phase, roll one D6. On a 1, the model suffers 1 mortal wound and cannot use this weapon further that phase. On a 2+ the model can fight with the weapon as normal.

profiles.name: Caliban Steel Blade
chars: Any attacks with a wound roll of 6+ made with this weapon have a Damage characteristic of D6 instead of D3.

profiles.name: Caliban Steel Blade
chars: Model with force sword only. The Caliban Steel Blade replaces the bearer’s force sword and has the profile below.

profiles.name: The Black Mace
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model is slain by the Black Mace; on a 6, that model's unit suffers an additional mortal wound at the end of the phase.

profiles.name: The Black Mace
chars: Models with a power maul or accursed crozius only. The Black Mace replaces the bearer's power maul or accursed crozius.

profiles.name: The Murder Sword
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn has begun, you must nominate one enemy CHARACTER to be the target of the bearer of the Murder Sword (this can be a character not yet set up on the battlefield). Remember to tell your opponent which character you have nominated. Each attack made with the Murder Sword that hits the selected character automatically inflicts a mortal wound upon that character instead of the normal damage.

profiles.name: The Murder Sword
chars: Models with a power sword only. The Murder sword replaces the bearer's power sword.

profiles.name: Eternal Vendetta
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by your Warlord in the Fight phase against targets with the ADEPTUS ASTARTES keyword.

profiles.name: Flames of Spite
chars: If the wound roll for a melee weapon attack made by your Warlord is 6+, it inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any other damage.

profiles.name: Unholy Fortitude
chars: Add 1 to the Wounds characteristic of your Warlord. In addition, roll a dice each time yourWarlord loses a wound. On a roll of 6, your warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Hatred Incarnate
chars: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by your Warlord.

profiles.name: Lord of Terror
chars: The opposing player must roll an extra dice when taking Morale tests for units within 6" of your Warlord, and use the highest result.

profiles.name: Exalted Champion
chars: Add 1 to your Warlord’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: Fallen Angels
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for any Fallen unit when shooting (including when firing Overwatch) as long as the unit did not move in its last Movement phase. In addition, Fallen units can never lose more than 1 model as the result of any single failed Morale test; any additional casualties beyond the first are ignored.

profiles.name: Chaos Rhino
chars: This model can transport 10 FALLEN INFANTRY models. It cannot, however, transport TERMINATORS , CULT OF DESTRUCTION or JUMP PACK models.

profiles.name: Self-repair
chars: Roll a D6 at the start of each of your turns; on a 6, this unit heals one wound.

profiles.name: Smoke Launchers
chars: Once per game, instead of shooting any weapons in the Shooting phase, this model can use its Smoke Launchers; until your next Shooting phase your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls for ranged weapons that target this vehicle.
